title: Linkdaze’s smart calendar is built to run a household, not just track a schedule | TechCrunch
summary: One of Linkdaze’s biggest strengths is its calendar compatibility. Instead of asking everyone to switch to a single calendar app, Linkdaze brings multiple schedules together and uses color coding to make individual family members easy to identify.
